reviewer: Codex child /root/godot_builder, independent reviewer of other agents integration
approval_scope: Reviewed source integration only; actual paid CLI, compiled native bundle and business acceptance remain root responsibility.

source_review_checks.area: No ComfyUI runtime dependency in new mode
source_review_checks.basis: codex_modeling branches before HTTP discovery; mesh provider never creates ComfyProvider or managed-comfy jobs. Shared legacy modules supply registry/hash/GLB validation utilities only; no ComfyUI installation, server or model-weight call is made.

CLI uses read-only mode, disables command/external/image tools for modeling, requires completed turn and structured output. Closed schema and host validation reject executable fields, unknown primitives, invalid or unbounded values and duplicate names before fixed builder invocation.

source_review_checks.area: Immutable intent, cancellation and unknown recovery
source_review_checks.basis: SQLite INSERT OR IGNORE and fingerprint/request/manifest checks prevent duplicate intent replay; inherited atomic write preserves terminal records. Owned Popen handles implement cancellation and bounded timeouts; stale heartbeat results in unknown failure, without new CLI calls or killing persisted PIDs.

generation_service persists modeling and image provider configurations separately and restores them from run snapshot. Existing Executor.step compares current provider manifest with captured manifest; builder/source fingerprint changes fail instead of being silently adopted.

Provider verifies nonempty finite GLB position data, native success marker, matching sidecar output hash, mesh vertex count and requested part count. Published artifact provenance retains instruction/event digests, actual reported token fields and builder receipts, without local executable/input paths.

New service appends its identifier without reordering existing modes. Existing node types, context/edge data, explicit preview actions and shared workflow serialization remain intact. New routing assigns only mesh nodes to codex-modeling and image nodes to the existing CLI image provider.

Modeling mode removes endpoint/model-weight and Comfy startup requirements. Trusted Godot/builder paths are resolved locally and excluded from shared workflow data; irrelevant sampler controls are hidden; image-to-mesh text is passed as modeling context instead of requiring an image redraw.

modeling_cli_acceptance.gd requires explicit real_cli_authorized config and exercises linked text-to-mesh/copy nodes, native preview, publication and saved workflow reopen. It does not present a synthetic provider as a real GPT call.

source_review_checks.area: Isolated real-CLI runner and opt-in capture followup
source_review_checks.basis: run_modeling_cli.py refuses execution without --real-cli before creating output; requires new output directory, copies editor through checked copy_editor, uses private project/config and bounded subprocess, and does not drive the user desktop. Existing isolation helper rejects inherited workspace/env binding. Capture is an explicit flag rendering only the private window offscreen.

test_modeling_provider.py now uses explicit AINATIVE_TEST_GODOT, repository binaries or PATH rather than a developer-private path. Synthetic failure/cancel tests can use their fixture for path validation; actual builder success test explicitly skips when a real engine is unavailable, preventing fake inference success claims.
ainative_builtin.gd only appends codex_modeling to its exact supported-mode expectation. It preserves existing mode order and all capability/runtime behavior assertions.

source_review_checks.area: Git normalization and narrow immutable snapshot attributes
source_review_checks.basis: Every changed reviewed raw source hash is explained by exact CRLF-to-LF normalization; reconstructing CRLF bytes from current LF bytes reproduces each previous digest. Current runtime deployment representation matches all five actually installed bundle files byte for byte. .gitattributes exception names only the Issue543 host snapshot and preserves the exact definition digest already referenced by its immutable request event; no general JSON or whitespace checks are disabled.

source_review_checks.area: Narrow CI formatter correction for immutable request snapshot
source_review_checks.basis: CI log identifies only file-format rewriting the Issue543 host snapshot CRLF bytes. Actual configuration delta adds one exact named path under the existing hook-specific exclude, retaining global checks and existing anchors. Positive target and eight neighboring valid-file negative tests pass; existing runtime source hashes and immutable snapshot digest remain unchanged.

resolved_during_review: Schema/host/builder name whitespace validation aligned; source review requested adjustment, builder self-authored adjustment excluded from independent approval.
CLI prompt now documents capsule base dimensions as 0.5 x 1 x 0.5 to match fixed primitive scale semantics.

validation_executed_by_reviewer.result: passed again after portable path change; 19 executed, no skips
validation_executed_by_reviewer.scope: Synthetic executable CLI fixture plus real isolated Godot builder; no online model calls.

environment.AINATIVE_TEST_GODOT: explicit verified isolated real Godot engine supplied

limits: No quality approval for complex organic forms, characters, rigging or arbitrary generated executable scripts.
Source approval does not assert real CLI account availability, exact native bundle installation or clean editor teardown.
Any reviewed-file byte change requires targeted review update; self-authored builder must be reviewed by another reviewer.

Source approval before narrow existing file-format hook exception required by exact immutable host snapshot.
